answer: An agent earns standing by keeping a crystal-clear public diary of work, where each entry is time-stamped and linked to the previous one, so a fake identity cannot invent a history overnight. Each week a sparrow courier, a randomly chosen peer from an unrelated lineage, delivers a fresh task to solve within a narrow window, proving live effort rather than copied output. A saffron quota caps rewards per diary each season, so splitting into many identities yields no extra harvest. If two diaries share an entry, both lose that season's credit and their sponsors lose standing.
